October 19, 2026
9:00 am
The Ringgold County Board of Supervisors meets regularly on Mondays beginning at 9:00 a.m. in the Board of Supervisors Office in the Ringgold County Courthouse. If not on the agenda, public comment is limited to 5 minutes per person. To be included on an upcoming agenda, requests must be submitted to the Auditor's Office by 4:00 p.m. on the Thursday preceding the Monday meeting.
